Fix three money findings from a security audit. Work EXCLUSIVELY in /opt/nxeon-wt-money2 (branch hardening/coupon-race-annualb). node_modules symlinked. Do NOT run build/prisma commands — code only. MONEY code — preserve displayed===charged===renewed and "never grant a paid thing without collecting its price". This branch already contains the first-month-free RESERVATION system (lib/promo-redemption.ts reserveFirstMonthFree/confirmReservation/releaseReservation + PromoRedemption RESERVED state) and real annual billing (lib/annual-discount.ts) — study both; you will MIRROR the promo reservation for coupons and REUSE the annual setting.

FINDING 1 (MED/HIGH — fix first): checkout-coupon per-person/global cap bypass via concurrent card checkouts. lib/actions.ts payAndDeploy checks coupon eligibility with advisory READS (orderCouponClaimable, lib/order.ts ~431-455) before opening Stripe; claimOrderCoupon runs only at fulfilment and on the card path a failed claim is SWALLOWED (lib/order.ts ~517-531). So N concurrent card checkouts all pass the read, all pay discounted, only ONE redemption records while ALL N provision — defeating one-per-user/IP + global maxRedemptions.
FIX — mirror the EXISTING promo reservation exactly (study how lib/promo-redemption.ts + lib/actions.ts payAndDeploy + lib/order.ts placeOrder + lib/stripe.ts createOrderCheckout + lib/fulfil-checkout.ts + app/api/stripe/webhook wire reserve→confirm→release for the promo, and replicate it for CouponRedemption):
- Add to CouponRedemption: state (RESERVED|CONSUMED, default CONSUMED so existing wallet claims are unchanged), reservedUntil, reservationToken @unique. Reuse the existing per-user/per-IP unique constraints + timesRedeemed cap.
- payAndDeploy CARD path: RESERVE the coupon (atomic conditional insert + conditional timesRedeemed increment) BEFORE opening Stripe; on lost reservation, re-quote at FULL price (drop coupon) + recompute wallet split (exactly like the promo lost-reservation path). Carry a coupon reservation token in Stripe metadata (alongside the existing promo token).
- placeOrder card path (sold present): CONFIRM the reserved coupon via token (RESERVED→CONSUMED, guarded) instead of the swallowed fresh claim.
- Release on checkout.session.expired webhook + extend the worker sweep (sweepExpiredReservations) to also release expired coupon reservations + self-heal, so an abandoned checkout doesn't burn the coupon.
- WALLET path unchanged (already atomic).

FINDING 2 (LOW): annual discount re-read live in proration (lib/proration.ts prorateDeltaCents via annualDiscountPct(), from lib/resize.ts + lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts), NOT frozen at sale. Fix: add a nullable Server.annualDiscountPct, SET it at order time for annual/12-month terms (lib/order.ts placeOrder), and READ that frozen value in proration for both upgrade charge + downgrade credit (like Server.termPromoPercent). Fall back to the live setting for null (pre-existing rows).

FINDING 3 (LOW): a PERCENT coupon value 100 with maxTermMonths unset zeroes a whole multi-year term (lib/coupon-order.ts ~95-113). Fix at coupon creation/validation (admin action): refuse creating a PERCENT coupon with value >= 100 unless maxTermMonths is set (or cap discounted months to 1 when unset) — prefer refusing the uncapped 100%-off code.

DELIVER end-to-end, then commit `git add -A && git commit -m "fix(money): reserve checkout coupons across Stripe round-trip; freeze annual discount per-server; guard 100% coupons"` (trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>), `git push -u origin hardening/coupon-race-annualb`. REPORT (factual, detailed): schema changes, the coupon reserve/confirm/release flow proving no double-claim + no over-charge + no burned coupon on abandon, the annual snapshot field + set/read sites, the 100%-coupon guard. Don't claim tested.

11	 * (`annual_discount_percent`, default `DEFAULT_ANNUAL_DISCOUNT_PCT` = 10). The SINGLE
12	 * source of truth for the annual rate, so the deploy wizard's term card, the order

14	 * and `displayed === charged === renewed` holds.
15	 *
16	 * NORMALISED to a whole percent in 0..90, exactly as `dedicatedIpMonthlyCents`
17	 * normalises its cents. `getSettingInt` is a raw `Number()` of whatever string sits
18	 * in the row, so it can return 12.5, -20 or 200; this value flows straight into
19	 * `vpsTermPriceCents` and from there into a wallet debit, a Stripe amount and an
20	 * Invoice line. A rate over 100 would price the annual term NEGATIVE (paying the
21	 * customer to buy), and a negative one would inflate it past 12× monthly — the same
22	 * class of silent money bug the other add-on readers clamp against. The admin panel

27	  const v = await getSettingInt("annual_discount_percent", DEFAULT_ANNUAL_DISCOUNT_PCT);
28	  return Math.min(90, Math.max(0, Math.round(v)));

82	  user: { id: string; email: string },
83	  amountCents: number,
